name: Green Pin Dee Shackle SC
desc: Green Pin® standard dee (D) shackle with screw collar pin. Bow and pin forged in high-tensile steel, grade 6, quenched and tempered; minimum breaking load equals 6× the working load limit. Hot-dipped galvanized for offshore corrosion resistance, rated −40°C to +200°C. Manufactured to ISO 2415 and EN 13889, meeting US Fed. Spec. RR-C-271 Type IVB Class 2; from 2 t upward it complies with ASME B30.26.
